predicate.label: died in place
predicate.definition: Person X, or an explicitly identified subset of population X, died in geographic place Y.
includes: being killed in Y establishing death there
excludes: residence, birth, or ordinary presence alone
Y is the perpetrator or cause rather than location
discussion of deaths without the affected person or population
ambiguous: a population mention without identified affected members
predicate.notes: This describes location of death, not where X lived or who caused death. An affected subset does not imply every member died.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit died-in or death-in location; being killed in Y establishing death there; historical death location. Excludes: residence, birth, or ordinary presence alone; Y is the perpetrator or cause rather than location; discussion of deaths without the affected person or population. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution unresolved; unclear death or geographic attachment; a population mention without identified affected members. This describes location of death, not where X lived or who caused death. An affected subset does not imply every member died.

rationale: Die-in12 plus death-in4/perish and fatal accident dominate; residence/rescue/escape and killing others do not establish source death.
